{{Otheruses|Archivist}}
The '''Royal archivist''' was a title held by individuals who handled the archives of the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]]. Brothers [[Jorec Gemen|Jorec]] and [[Mard Gemen]] were two Royal archivists during the tenure of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel]] and the early rule of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Atai Molec/Legends|Atai Molec]], before they were reassigned to [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Sono Molec/Legends|Sono Molec's]] outpost on [[Kowak/Legends|Kowak]].<ref name="SFriends Like These">''[[Friends Like These]]''</ref>
